name: greatsword_v1
_doc: Knight's planted greatsword compiled standalone (GOLEM v0.3 box vocabulary). Parts from the fable-a design brief. blade+crossguard are rounded boxes; grip is a gencyl; pommel a blob. AABB note: 'round' is additive OUTWARD, so the compiled mesh extent on an axis = 2*(core_half + round) for the bounding part. Core (round-excluded) extents are x=0.68 (2*0.34), z=0.14 (2*0.07); TOTAL compiled extents are x=0.74, y=1.76, z=0.20 -- the harness asserts the true total extents. blade core flatness size_x/size_z = 0.16/0.035 = 4.57 (a flat cross-section a round gencyl cannot make).
